summary: Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, NYSE: P) gave FY2028 revenue guidance of $7.0-7.3B at its 2026-09-23 investor day, above the ~$6.5B consensus; stock jumped about 11-18% on 9/24. Earlier boosts: joined the S&P 500 on 9/21, beat Q2 on 8/26.
support_reason: Raised multi-year guidance, earnings beats, a second hyperscaler design win and S&P 500 inclusion; upgrades from BofA, Guggenheim and others.
dilution_or_offering: none found; ongoing insider Form 4 sales (about $80M last quarter)
